name: Holistics
tagline: AI-assisted self-service BI built on a programmable, governed semantic layer.
description: Holistics is a business intelligence platform that lets data teams define centralized metrics and modeling logic in a programmable semantic layer, then lets business users explore the data through AI queries or point-and-click without writing SQL. Its AI reasons over the governed semantic layer — generating AQL (Analytics Query Language) rather than raw text-to-SQL — so answers stay grounded in defined metrics, with lineage, multi-turn context, and Git-based version control for analytics-as-code.
insight: Bootstrapped since 2015 with no outside VC; reached about $5M revenue with a roughly 37-person team by 2024.
edge: Its AI reasons over a governed semantic layer (AQL) so answers stay grounded in defined metrics — verifiable BI, not ad-hoc text-to-SQL.
pros: Analytics-as-code with Git and dbt integration
cons: Semantic-layer modeling has a setup cost
Smaller ecosystem than incumbent BI suites
